result.summary: A truncated PNG header passes the image preview classifier. New image killer fails against production; other bounded-image scenarios pass. Final approval awaits fix and rerun.
result.plainSummary: A damaged image can be presented as an integrity-checked screenshot instead of being rejected.

findings.gap: attachmentEvidence accepts a 24-byte PNG prefix containing signature and IHDR dimensions, without complete image chunks; status verified and imageDataUrl are returned.
findings.plainImpact: People can receive a broken screenshot preview even though the saved file was classified as a supported image.
findings.fixProposal: Check bounded PNG/JPEG structure before returning a preview; reject truncated headers and missing image payload/end markers.

evidence.citedTest: packages/ledger/src/session/visual-evidence.break.test.ts::visual breaker: truncated image headers cannot be offered as valid previews

residualRisks: One out-of-intent killer: exhausted image budget preserves independent text findings.
